_doc: SSL Division B field geometry in millimetres (defaults of ssl-unification DataWorld.h / ssl-vision SSL_GeometryFieldSize; RoboCup SSL rules: playing area 9 x 6 m, goal 1 m wide and 0.18 m deep, defense area 2 x 1 m, penalty mark 6 m from the goal centre, 6 robots per team). Consumed by dtssl.config.load_field / load_field_preset (dtssl.sim.world.FieldGeometry.from_mm) and by the vision publisher (geometry packet). robots_per_team is read by the GUI/CLI (robots on the field at start), not by FieldGeometry. Division A: field_divA.json.
